morceaux.1:
<head type="main">P. OVIDI NASONIS EPISTVLAE HEROIDVM</head>
<head type="poem">IX. Deianira Herculi</head>
<lg type="strophe">
<l n="1">Mittor ad <persName>Alciden</persName> a coniuge conscia mentis</l>
<l n="2">littera si coniunx <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Deianira</name> tua est.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.2:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Gratulor <persName>Oechaliam</persName> titulis accedere nostris,</l>
  <l n="2">victorem victae succubuisse queror.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="3">fama <placeName>Pelasgiadas</placeName> subito pervenit in urbes</l>
  <l n="4">decolor et factis infitianda tuis,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">quem numquam <name type="deity">Iuno</name> seriesque inmensa laborum</l>
  <l n="6">fregerit, huic <persName>Iolen</persName> inposuisse iugum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="7">hoc velit <persName>Eurystheus</persName>, velit hoc germana <name type="deity">Tonantis</name>,</l>
  <l n="8">laetaque sit vitae labe noverca tuae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">at non ille velit, cui nox (si creditur) una</l>
  <l n="10">non tanti, ut tantus conciperere, fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="11">Plus tibi quam <name type="deity">Iuno</name> nocuit <name type="deity">Venus</name>: illa premendo</l>
  <l n="12">sustulit, haec humili sub pede colla tenet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="13">respice vindicibus pacatum viribus orbem,</l>
  <l n="14">qua latam <name type="deity">Nereus</name> caerulus ambit humum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="15">se tibi pax terrae, tibi se tuta aequora debent;</l>
  <l n="16">implesti meritis <persName>Solis</persName> utramque domum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="17">quod te laturum est, caelum prius ipse tulisti:</l>
  <l n="18"><persName>Hercule</persName> supposito sidera fulsit <persName>Atlans</persName>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="19">quid nisi notitia est misero quaesita pudori,</l>
  <l n="20">si cumulas sturpi facta priora nota?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">tene ferunt geminos pressisse tenaciter <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">angues</name>,</l>
  <l n="22">cum tener in cunis iam <persName>Iove</persName> dignus eras?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="23">coepisti melius quam desinis; ultima primis</l>
  <l n="24">cedunt: dissimiles hic vir et ille puer.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="25">quem non mille <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ferae</name>, quem non <persName>Stheneleius</persName> hostis,</l>
  <l n="26">non potuit <name type="deity">Iuno</name> vincere, vincit <name type="deity">Amor</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="27">At bene nupta feror, quia nominer <persName>Herculis</persName> uxor,</l>
  <l n="28">sitque socer, rapidis qui tonat altus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equis</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="29">quam male inaequales veniunt ad aratra <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">iuvenci</name>,</l>
  <l n="30">tam premitur magno coniuge nupta minor.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">non honor est sed onus species laesura ferentes:</l>
  <l n="32">siqua voles apte nubere, nube pari.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="33">vir mihi semper abest, et coniuge notior hospes</l>
</lg>
morceaux.3:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">monstraque terribiles persequiturque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">feras</name>.</l>
  <l n="2">ipsa domo vidua votis operata pudicis</l>
  <l n="3">torqueor, infesto ne <persName>vir</persName> ab <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">hoste</name> cadat;</l>
  <l n="4">inter <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">serpentes</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aprosque</name> avidosque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">leones</name></l>
  <l n="5">iactor et haesuros terna per ora <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canes</name>.</l>
  <l n="6">me <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pecudum</name> fibrae simulacraque inania <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">somni</name></l>
  <l n="7">omniaque arcana nocte petita movent.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.4:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">aucupor infelix incertae murmura famae</l>
  <l n="2">speque timor dubia spesque timore cadit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="3">mater abest queriturque deo placuisse potenti,</l>
  <l n="4">nec pater Amphitryon nec puer Hyllus adest.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">arbiter Eurystheus astu Iunonis iniquae</l>
  <l n="6">sentitur nobis iraque longa deae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="7">Haec mihi ferre parum; peregrinos addis amores,</l>
  <l n="8">et mater de te quaelibet esse potest.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">non ego Partheniis temeratam vallibus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Augen</name></l>
  <l n="10">nec referam partus, Ormeni nympha, tuos;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="11">non tibi crimen erunt, <placeName>Teuthrantia</placeName> turba, sorores,</l>
  <l n="12">quarum de populo nulla relicta tibi est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="13">una, recens crimen, referetur adultera nobis,</l>
  <l n="14">unde ego sum Lydo facta noverca <persName>Lamo</persName>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="15"><placeName>Maeandros</placeName>, totiens qui terris errat in isdem,</l>
  <l n="16">qui lassas in se saepe retorquet aquas,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="17">vidit in <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Herculeo</name> suspensa monilia collo,</l>
  <l n="18">illo, cui caelum sarcina parva fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="19">non puduit fortes auro cohibere lacertos</l>
  <l n="20">et solidis gemmas opposuisse toris?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">nempe sub his animam pestis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Nemeaea</name> lacertis</l>
  <l n="22">edidit, unde umerus tegmina laevus habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="23">ausus es hirsutos mitra redimire capillos!</l>
  <l n="24">aptior <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Herculeae</name> populus alba comae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="25">nec te <foreign xml:lang="la">Maeonia</foreign> lascivae more puellae</l>
  <l n="26">incingi zona dedecuisse pudet?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="27">non tibi succurrit crudi <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Diomedis</name> imago,</l>
  <l n="28">efferus humana qui dape pavit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equas</name>?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="29">si te vidisset cultu <persName>Busiris</persName> in isto,</l>
  <l n="30">huic victor victo nempe pudendus eras!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">detrahat <persName>Antaeus</persName> duro redimicula collo,</l>
  <l n="32">ne pigeat molli succubuisse viro!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="33">Inter Ioniacas calathum tenuisse puellas</l>
  <l n="34">diceris et dominae pertimuisse minas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="35">non fugis, <persName>Alcide</persName>, victricem mille laborum</l>
</lg>
morceaux.5:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">rasilibus <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">calathis</name> inposuisse manum</l>
  <l n="2">crassaque robusto deducis pollice fila</l>
  <l n="3">aequaque formosae pensa rependis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">erae</name>?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="4">a! quotiens, digitis dum torques stamina duris,</l>
  <l n="5">praevalidae fusos conminuere manus!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="6">[<quote><foreign xml:lang="la">Crederis infelix scuticae tremefactis habenis</foreign></quote></l>
  <l n="7"><foreign xml:lang="la">ante pedes dominae pertimuisse minas ...</foreign></l>
  <l n="8"><foreign xml:lang="la">eximiis pompis, immania semina laudim]</foreign></l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">factaque narrabas dissimulanda tibi:</l>
  <l n="10">scilicet: immanes elisis faucibus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">hydros</name></l>
  <l n="11"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">infantem</name> caudis involuisse manum;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="12">ut <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Tegeaeus</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aper</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">cupressifero</name> <placeName>Erymantho</placeName></l>
  <l n="13">incubet et vasto pondere laedat humum;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="14">non tibi <name type="placeName">Threiciis</name> adfixa penatibus ora,</l>
  <l n="15">non hominum pingues caede tacentur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equae</name>,</l>
  <l n="16">prodigiumque triplex, armenti dives <placeName>Hiberi</placeName></l>
  <l n="17"><persName>Geryones</persName>, quamvis in tribus unus erat;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="18">inque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canes</name> totidem trunco digestus ab uno</l>
  <l n="19"><name type="deity">Cerberos</name> implicitis angue minante comis;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="20">quaeque redundabat fecundo vulnere <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">serpens</name></l>
  <l n="21">fertilis et damnis dives ab ipsa suis,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="22">et qui inter laevumque latus laevumque lacertum</l>
  <l n="23">praegrave conpressa fauce pependit onus,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="24">et male confisum pedibus formaque bimembri</l>
  <l n="25">pulsum <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Thessalicis</name> agmen equestre iugis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="26"><persName>Haec</persName> tu <placeName>Sidonio</placeName> potes insignitus amictu</l>
  <l n="27">dicere? non cultu lingua retenta silet?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="28">se quoque <persName>nympha</persName> tuis ornavit <placeName>Dardanis</placeName> armis</l>
  <l n="29">et tulit a capto nota tropaea viro.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="30">i nunc, tolle animos et fortia gesta recense:</l>
  <l n="31">quo tu non esses, iure vir illa fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="32">qua tanto minor es, quanto te, maxime rerum,</l>
  <l n="33">quam quos vicisti, vincere maius erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="34">illi procedit rerum mensura tuarum,</l>
  <l n="35">cede bonis: heres laudis amica tuae.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.6:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">o pudor! <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">leonis</name> hirsuti costis exuta</l>
  <l n="2">aspera texerunt vellera molle latus!</l>
  <l n="3">falleris et nescis: non sunt spolia illa <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">leonis</name>,</l>
  <l n="4">sed tua, tuque feri victor es, illa tui.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">femina tela tulit <placeName>Lernaeis</placeName> atra venenis,</l>
  <l n="6">ferre gravem lana vix satis apta colum,</l>
  <l n="7">instruxitque manum clava domitrice ferarum</l>
  <l n="8">vidit et in speculo coniugis arma sui.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">Haec tamen audieram; licuit non credere famae,</l>
  <l n="10">et venit ad sensus mollis ab aure dolor.</l>
  <l n="11">ante meos oculos adducitur advena paelex,</l>
  <l n="12">nec mihi, quae patior, dissimulare licet!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="13">non sinis averti: mediam captiva per urbem</l>
  <l n="14">invitis oculis adspicienda venit.</l>
  <l n="15">nec venit incultis captarum more capillis:</l>
  <l n="16">fortunam vultu fassa decente suam</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="17">ingreditur late lato spectabilis auro,</l>
  <l n="18">qualiter in <placeName>Phrygia</placeName> tu quoque cultus eras;</l>
  <l n="19">dat vultum populo sublimis ut <name type="deity">Hercule</name> victo:</l>
  <l n="20">Oechaliam vivo stare parente putes;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">forsitan et pulsa <placeName>Aetolide</placeName> <persName>Deianira</persName></l>
  <l n="22">nomine deposito paelicis uxor erit,</l>
  <l n="23"><persName>Eurytidos</persName>que <persName>Ioles</persName> Atque <placeName>Aonii</placeName> <persName>Alcidae</persName></l>
  <l n="24">turpia famosus corpora iunget <name type="deity">Hymen</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="25">mens fugit admonitu, frigusque perambulat artus,</l>
  <l n="26">et iacet in gremio languida facta manus.</l>
  <l n="27">Me quoque cum multis, sed me sine crimine amasti;</l>
  <l n="28">ne pigeat, pugnae bis tibi causa fui.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="29">cornua flens legit ripis <placeName>Achelous</placeName> in udis</l>
  <l n="30">truncaque limosa tempora mersit aqua;</l>
  <l n="31">semivir occubuit in letifero <placeName>Eueno</placeName></l>
  <l n="32"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Nessus</name> et infecit sanguis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equinus</name> aquas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="33">sed quid ego haec refero? scribenti nuntia venit</l>
  <l n="34">fama virum tunicae tabe perire meae.</l>
  <l n="35">ei mihi! quid feci? quo me furor egit amantem?</l>
</lg>
morceaux.7:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">impia quid dubitas <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Deianira</name> mori?</l>
  <l n="2">An tuus in media coniunx <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Oeta</name>,</l>
  <l n="3">tu sceleris tanti causa superstes eris?</l>
  <l n="4">siquid adhuc habeo facti, cur <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Herculis</name> uxor</l>
  <l n="5">credar, coniugii mors mea pignus erit.</l>
  <l n="6">tu quoque cognosces in me, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Meleagre</name>, sororem!</l>
  <l n="7">impia quid dubitas <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Deianira</name> mori?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="8">Heu devota domus! solio sedet <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Agrios</name> alto;</l>
  <l n="9"><name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Oenea</name> desertum nuda senecta premit;</l>
  <l n="10">exulat ignotis <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Tydeus</name> germanus in oris;</l>
  <l n="11">alter fatali vivus in igne fuit;</l>
  <l n="12">exegit ferrum sua per praecordia mater.</l>
  <l n="13">impia quid dubitas <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Deianira</name> mori?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="14">Deprecor hoc unum per iura sacerrima lecti,</l>
  <l n="15">ne videar fatis insidiata tuis.</l>
  <l n="16"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Nessus</name>, ut est avidum percussus harundine pectus,</l>
  <l n="17">"hic," dixit, "vires sanguis amoris habet."</l>
  <l n="18">illita <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Nesseo</name> misi tibi texta veneno.</l>
  <l n="19">impia quid dubitas <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Deianira</name> mori?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="20">Iamque vale, seniorque pater germanaque <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Gorge</name></l>
  <l n="21">et patria et patriae frater adempte tuae</l>
  <l n="22">et tu lux oculis hodierna novissima nostris</l>
  <l n="23">virque—sed o possis!—et puer <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Hylle</name>, vale!</l>
</lg>
